text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Narita Taishin didn't show up even though it was time for training,
so when I went looking for her—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: "...Another easy win! The arcade version isn't really that different from the app, huh."

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Alright!
I'm gonna keep this win streak going!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Who the heck is this "Wagahai-chan"?!
Darting around all over the place since earlier...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Our skills seemed pretty evenly matched, though...
Damn it, next time I'm definitely taking the win!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Huh? ...Wait, is it that late already?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I accepted her apology
and warned her to be more careful in the future.
